related_work: The self-review had three parts: what I did well, what I need to improve, and how to improve it. Miha said if you don’t know how to improve, that’s a sign you should ask for help. The workshop looked at access in three ways: language and understanding, physical access, and intersectional things like gender, race, class and culture.
conclusion_future_work: This class helped me think about who might be left out of my work.I will use today’s feedback, and submit it again before Wednesday, 4 November.
results_discussion: For my Project 1, I thought about two main things. First, my work may be uses a camera, so it may collect private data, like people’s faces . If it does, we need to ask users for their permission first. Second, some disabled people may come to the exhibition, so we need to think about them too. Miha said we can’t remove every barrier, but we should be honest and tell people about them before they come.
title: week6
introduction: This week,  we did a short grounding exercise: we looked around and named two colours and two sounds. Then we wrote a self-review of our Practice Grid and swapped it with a classmate. In the second half, we had a workshop about accessible practice.
